title: Musk subtraction pass
description: Applies Musk's algorithm (question requirements, delete, then simplify) to GSD planning: challenges milestones, requirements and implementation before they are built, routes small phases through the leanest workflow that will do, logs every cut in a ledger, and prices the savings from your real Claude Code token usage.

notes.*: Hooks and ledger work on every runtime. Token calibration reads Claude Code transcripts; other runtimes fall back to labelled priors.

musk.enabled.description: Enable the musk subtraction pass. On by default: installing the capability is the opt-in. Set false in a project to opt that project out.

musk.scope_cuts.description: How scope cuts (dropping a requirement, success criterion or phase) are handled. defer: apply reversibly (move to v2 / backlog, record a [deferred] decision, mark inferred for audit) without asking. propose: log proposals only and keep full scope. ask: ask the user for each batch of cuts. Implementation cuts never remove a sourced requirement and are always applied.

musk.lean_lane.description: Small phases (3 tasks or fewer, one subsystem, no new dependency, no open user question) take the lean lane: CONTEXT.md is written without gray-area questioning, research is skipped, and the phase gets one plan.

musk.milestone_pass.description: Run the one-shot milestone subtraction (musk-roadmap) at the first discuss of a milestone, before any phase has context or plans.
